say:0:1820903001:1.text: A moth lands on the flower rack, and you quickly lean in for a closer look.
say:0:1820903001:1.source_cn: 一只飞蛾碰巧落在花架上，你连忙凑近仔细观察。
say:0:1820903001:1.male: A moth lands on the flower rack, and you quickly lean in for a closer look.
say:0:1820903001:1.female: A moth lands on the flower rack, and you quickly lean in for a closer look.

say:1:1820903002:0.text: There can be no doubt that <style="highlight">this is the same kind of moth Tephesia used to make the antidote</style>. Could these moths be protecting the hornleaf bear?
say:1:1820903002:0.male: There can be no doubt that <style="highlight">this is the same kind of moth Tephesia used to make the antidote</style>. Could these moths be protecting the hornleaf bear?
say:1:1820903002:0.female: There can be no doubt that <style="highlight">this is the same kind of moth Tephesia used to make the antidote</style>. Could these moths be protecting the hornleaf bear?

say:2:1820903003:1.text: The moth takes flight. As its patterned wings flicker through the air, you become increasingly certain you've seen that design somewhere before...
say:2:1820903003:1.source_cn: 飞蛾腾空而起。你看着它飞舞的样子，越看越觉得仿佛在某样...
say:2:1820903003:1.male: The moth takes flight. As its patterned wings flicker through the air, you become increasingly certain you've seen that design somewhere before...
say:2:1820903003:1.female: The moth takes flight. As its patterned wings flicker through the air, you become increasingly certain you've seen that design somewhere before...

say:3:1820903004:2.text: ... The souvenirs from Seasong Theater! <style="highlight">The butterfly ornaments tied to the candle blossom stems were made from these moth wings</style>!
say:3:1820903004:2.male: ... The souvenirs from Seasong Theater! <style="highlight">The butterfly ornaments tied to the candle blossom stems were made from these moth wings</style>!
say:3:1820903004:2.female: ... The souvenirs from Seasong Theater! <style="highlight">The butterfly ornaments tied to the candle blossom stems were made from these moth wings</style>!

say:4:1820903005:1.text: Senea said Tephesia came up with the idea of using candle blossoms for the souvenirs... So who put those moths there, which could be the key to undoing the infection?
say:4:1820903005:1.source_cn: 按照塞涅的说法，提议用赤烛蕊制作纪念品的人是苔佩希……...
say:4:1820903005:1.male: Senea said Tephesia came up with the idea of using candle blossoms for the souvenirs... So who put those moths there, which could be the key to undoing the infection?
say:4:1820903005:1.female: Senea said Tephesia came up with the idea of using candle blossoms for the souvenirs... So who put those moths there, which could be the key to undoing the infection?

say:5:1820903006:2.text: You don't want to believe it, but every clue points straight to Tephesia. You've never seen these moths anywhere except in her hands and her greenhouse.
say:5:1820903006:2.source_cn: 你心中隐隐有一个猜测，却又觉得匪夷所思：毕竟你只在苔佩...
say:5:1820903006:2.male: You don't want to believe it, but every clue points straight to Tephesia. You've never seen these moths anywhere except in her hands and her greenhouse.
say:5:1820903006:2.female: You don't want to believe it, but every clue points straight to Tephesia. You've never seen these moths anywhere except in her hands and her greenhouse.

say:7:1820903008:1.text: There are no answers here. You'll have to keep going.
say:7:1820903008:1.source_cn: 或许只有继续深入，才能解开你的种种疑惑。
say:7:1820903008:1.male: There are no answers here. You'll have to keep going.
say:7:1820903008:1.female: There are no answers here. You'll have to keep going.
